title: Inflow
tagline: Next gen Decentralized Payment Infrastructure for high value assets
description:
This project combine, On ramp technology, the standard ERC-4337, NFC ship technology and 1inch fusion SDK to provide a conditioned payment infrastructure for (Tokenized) high value assets.
Inflow is design to make the payment for web2 users of web3 product easier and seamless to provide a simpler, frictionless and intent first onboarding.
how_its_made:
The technology used is : 
- Arx to make the payment initialization and process through to clothe itself, we've got a lot of complication to connect the halo NFC ship to with our solution, but we got a script that doing what we want to do. 
- ERC-4337 account abstraction, to have a programmable one click custom onboarding process.
- Crypto unlimit SDK to make the bridge from Fiat to Crypto.
- 1inch Fusion SDK for Atomic swap from some ETH to APECOIN embedded inside the SCW, we've had a bit of struggle to add it end to end, but the contracts are deployed. 
- Push protocol to emit notifications related to the SCW.
